verdict.rationale: Bolna documents its own post-call AI analysis: an optional per-agent call summary toggle, and extraction categories that pair a name with a model and attach to an agent. This is a basic form of automated call review, but nothing shows the platform scoring call quality, flagging failed calls, or assessing resolution. missing for 10: automatic call quality scoring, failure flagging/alerts, resolution analysis, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically

citations.quote: POST /agent/{agent_id}/extraction-categories — create a category (name + model) and attach it to an agent
Call summaries are an agent-level toggle: call_summary_enabled (boolean, off by default) on the agent create and update APIs
Configure webhooks, call summaries, and extractions for Bolna Voice AI.
